+/** Read the native CURRENT request envelope, never cumulative accounting usage. */
+export function mountLegionContext(scoped, ctx, { store, legion, run, task, message, onCommanderCompact }) {
+  let warned=false,summary
+  let currentAgent
+  scoped.on('agent/request',async({agent},next)=>{currentAgent=agent;return next()})
+  scoped.on('session/event',async(session,event)=>{
+    if(event.type!=='request/header')return
+    const header=event.data.header,meter=ctx.get('tokenMeter')
+    if(!meter)return
+    const info=await ctx.get('llm').resolveModelInfo(header.config.provider,header.config.model),capacity=info.context?.contextWindow
+    if(!capacity)return
+    const tokens=meter.measure(session,header).totalTokens+(header.config.maxTokens??info.defaultMaxTokens??0),ratio=tokens/capacity
+    if(run){const current=store.run(run.id);current.contextPressure={source:'dsh-token-meter',tokens,capacity,ratio};store.saveRun(current)}
+    if(ratio<0.75)warned=false
+    if(ratio>=0.85&&!warned&&currentAgent?.status==='running'){warned=true;currentAgent.inject(message('Native current context pressure is '+Math.round(ratio*100)+'%. Save full confirmed STATE with legion_state now. Preserve unknown outcomes. DSH owns automatic compaction; do not invoke manual compaction.'))}
+  })
+  scoped.on('session/event',(session,event)=>{
+    if(event.type==='compaction/summary')summary=event.data?.summary?.filter(b=>b.type==='text').map(b=>b.text).join('\n')
+    if(event.type!=='compaction/end'||event.data?.error||!summary)return
+    warned=false
+    if(run){
+      const step=store.node(run.projectId,run.stepId,'step')
+      const state=JSON.stringify({source:'native-compaction',stepId:step.id,goalId:step.goalId,taskKey:step.taskKey,summary,predecessorRunId:run.id,sourceIds:step.sourceIds,factIds:step.factIds})
+      legion.queueHandoff(run.id,state);legion.settleHandoff(run.id)
+    }else onCommanderCompact?.(summary)
+    summary=undefined
+  })
+}

+import type { EngineConfig } from './types.ts'
+const execFileAsync=promisify(execFile)
+export async function tsecbenchQuery(config: EngineConfig, args: string[], signal?: AbortSignal) {
+  const script = path.join(path.dirname(config.workspaceRoot), '.redtrace', 'skills', 'tsecbench-api', 'scripts', 'tsecbench.py')
+  try {
+    const { stdout } = await execFileAsync(process.env.REDTRACE_BENCHMARK_PYTHON || 'python3', [script, ...args], {
+      cwd: path.dirname(script), env: toolEnvironment(config.commonEnv), signal, timeout: 45_000, maxBuffer: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
+    })
+    const response = JSON.parse(stdout)
+    if (response?.ok === false) throw new HttpError(502, response.message ?? response.error ?? 'TSecBench SDK failure', response)
+    return response?.[args[0]] ?? response
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (error instanceof HttpError) throw error
+    const failure = error as { stdout?: string; stderr?: string; code?: string; killed?: boolean; message?: string }
+    for (const text of [failure.stderr, failure.stdout]) {
+      try { const parsed = JSON.parse(text ?? ''); throw new HttpError(502, parsed.message ?? parsed.error ?? 'TSecBench SDK failure', parsed) } catch (parsedError) { if (parsedError instanceof HttpError) throw parsedError }
+    }
+    throw new HttpError(502, failure.killed ? 'TSecBench query timed out; execution outcome may be unknown' : 'TSecBench query failed', { code: failure.code ?? null, message: failure.message ?? null })
+  }
+}
+
+
+export async function benchmarkInstance(store:Store,config:EngineConfig,projectId:string,code:string,action:'start'|'close',signal?:AbortSignal) {
+  const origin=store.node(projectId,'origin','fact')
+  if(!('description'in origin)||!/(?:tsecbench|tsec[\s-]*benchmark)/i.test(origin.description))throw new HttpError(403,'Project Scope does not authorize the benchmark platform')
+  const legion=new LegionStore(store)
+  if(action==='close')legion.assertInstanceClose(projectId,code)
+  const response=await tsecbenchQuery(config,[action,code],signal)
+  if(action==='start') {
+    if(response.unique_code!==code||!Array.isArray(response.container_addr)||!response.container_addr.length)throw new HttpError(502,'Platform returned an invalid challenge or target list')
+    const hosts=response.container_addr.map((value:unknown)=>{if(typeof value!=='string')throw new HttpError(502,'Invalid target address');const url=new URL(/^https?:/.test(value)?value:'http://'+value);if(url.username||url.password)throw new HttpError(502,'Credential-bearing target rejected');return url.host.toLowerCase()})
+    store.setBenchmarkHosts(projectId,code,hosts)
+    store.addInput(projectId,'observation','Platform started '+code+'; authorized targets: '+response.container_addr.join(', '),'commander')
+  }else { if(response?.closed!==true)throw new HttpError(502,'Platform close is unconfirmed; retain instance state and verify before retry',response);store.setBenchmarkHosts(projectId,code) }
+  legion.platformEvent(projectId,code,action,response);return response
+}

+import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'

+/** E7 only: evidence preparation is never a runtime-deletion permission. */
+export async function cutoverPreflight(store:Store,evidence:ProjectEvidence,services:EvidenceSessionServices){
+ const projects=[]
+ for(const project of store.projects())projects.push(await evidence.preflightReset(project.id,services))
+ return{projects,dataReady:projects.every(p=>p.dataReady),sessions:(await services.sessionPersistence.list()).map(s=>({id:s.header.id,revision:s.revision}))}
+}
+export function resetLegionRuntime(store:Store,evidence:ProjectEvidence,plan:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof cutoverPreflight>>,backup:{path:string;sha256:string}){
+ if(createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(backup.path)).digest('hex')!==backup.sha256)throw new HttpError(409,'Verified backup hash changed')
+ if(!plan.dataReady||plan.projects.some(p=>!p.dataReady))throw new HttpError(409,'Evidence/runtime preflight has blockers')
+ if(JSON.stringify(plan.projects.map(p=>p.projectId).sort())!==JSON.stringify(store.projects().map(p=>p.id).sort()))throw new HttpError(409,'Project inventory changed after preservation')
+ const legion=new LegionStore(store)
+ if(legion.campaign().status==='running'||store.runs().some(r=>['running','paused','unknown'].includes(r.status)||r.pendingTools.length))throw new HttpError(409,'Execution is not confirmed stopped')
+ const count=(table:string)=>Number(store.db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM '+table).get()!.n)
+ const before={steps:Number(store.db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM nodes WHERE kind='step'").get()!.n),runs:count('runs'),auditRuns:count('audit_runs')}
+ store.transaction(()=>{
+  for(const p of plan.projects){if(store.project(p.projectId).revision!==p.observedRevision)throw new HttpError(409,'Project changed after preservation');for(const node of p.detachments)store.saveNode(node.after)}
+  for(const table of ['audit_runs','runs','legion_messages','legion_tasks','campaign','critical_keys','events'])store.db.exec('DELETE FROM '+table)
+  store.db.exec("DELETE FROM nodes WHERE kind='step'")
+  const table=(name:string)=>!!store.db.prepare("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?").get(name)
+  if(table('resource_leases'))store.db.exec('DELETE FROM resource_leases')
+  if(table('shared_resources'))store.db.exec('UPDATE shared_resources SET intent_id=NULL')
+  if(table('operation_tasks'))store.db.exec('UPDATE operation_tasks SET intent_id=NULL')
+  for(const project of store.projects()){
+   if(project.status==='active'||project.status==='deleting')throw new HttpError(409,'Project scheduling is not stopped')
+   for(const node of store.nodes(project.id,['fact','finding','goal','hint','observation']))store.event(project.id,node.kind==='hint'?'hint.added':node.kind+'.retained',node,{})
+   store.event(project.id,'project.legion_cutover',null,{backupSha256:backup.sha256})
+  }
+  const campaign=legion.campaign();legion.saveCampaign({...campaign,hasSession:false,status:'stopped',state:'Runtime cleared after verified evidence preservation and backup. Projects remain stopped; explicit resume only.'})
+  store.db.prepare('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO metadata VALUES (?,?)').run('legion-cutover',JSON.stringify({at:now(),backupSha256:backup.sha256}))
+ })
+ for(const p of plan.projects)for(const row of store.db.prepare('SELECT id FROM project_artifacts WHERE project_id=?').all(p.projectId))evidence.read(p.projectId,String(row.id))

+}

+function sessionServices(root: string, projectId: string, entries: { id: string; events: unknown[]; cwd?: string }[] = [], objects = new Map<string, Uint8Array>()) {
+  const closed: string[] = []
+  const read = (ref: any) => { const bytes = objects.get(ref.attachmentId); if (!bytes) throw new Error('Attachment object is missing'); return bytes }
+  return { closed, objects, entries, sessionPersistence: {
+    async list() { return entries.map(entry => ({ header: { id: entry.id, cwd: entry.cwd ?? path.join(root, projectId) }, revision: 'fixture-1' })) },
+    async stat() { return { revision: 'fixture-1' } },
+    async open(id: string, access: 'read') { assert.equal(access, 'read'); return { async read() { return { events: entries.find(entry => entry.id === id)!.events } }, async close() { closed.push(id) } } },
+  }, attachments: { async readImage(ref: any) { return { data: read(ref) } }, async *readFileStream(ref: any) { yield read(ref) } } }
+}
+function attachment(bytes: string, image = false) {
+  const data = Buffer.from(bytes), attachmentId = 'sha256:' + createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex')
+  return { data, ref: { attachmentId, bytes: data.length, name: 'fixture.bin', ...(image ? { mediaType: 'image/png', width: 1, height: 1 } : {}) } }

 ## 接入与工具
